text: Machine learning models learn patterns from data without being explicitly programmed.
Deep learning relies on neural networks with multiple hidden layers.
Transformer architectures dominate natural language processing tasks.
Vector databases index high-dimensional embeddings for similarity search.
FAISS is a library for efficient similarity search of dense vectors.
Approximate nearest neighbour algorithms trade recall for speed.
Kubernetes orchestrates containerised workloads across nodes.
Prometheus scrapes time-series metrics from instrumented endpoints.
Observability covers logs, metrics, and distributed traces.
Italian pasta is made from durum wheat semolina and water.
Thai green curry uses coconut milk, green chillies, and Thai basil.
Sushi rice is short-grain and seasoned with rice vinegar and sugar.
Espresso is brewed by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee.
Relational databases enforce schemas and store data in normalised tables.
Postgres supports JSONB, full-text search, and write-ahead logging.
Sharding distributes data across multiple servers by partition key.
Redis is an in-memory data structure store used for caching and queues.
Kafka is a distributed log used for event streaming at high throughput.
ONNX is an open exchange format for representing neural network models.
Model quantisation reduces precision to lower memory and increase speed.
